$comment: Editorial layer merged over the seed lists by scripts/harvest.mjs. bestFor: one line on the product it suits. family: groups ports/variants of one system so agents show at most one per family. brandLocked: the visual identity belongs to a specific company or government; reason is shown to agents. productShapes: what kind of product UI it is good at (see shapes vocabulary).

shapes.app-dashboard: Data-heavy app screens: tables, filters, charts, forms
shapes.saas-app: General product UI for a web app
shapes.content-site: Docs, blogs, catalogs, directories, long-form reading
